title: Meow
description: Crisp fintech light: a white page with pale-grey panels, near-black ink text and a deep blue-black for the hero, stat card and footer. One hot orange for first-screen CTAs, a clear blue as the second accent, green status dots. Small 4px corners, hairline rules, no shadows. A plain neo-grotesk at 400 and 500. Dark sibling: the whole page in that blue-black ink.
notes: light is the faithful mode; the hero, big stat card and footer use the dark tokens in both modes (they carry the class `dark`)
Public Sans stands in for the original's closed Untitled Sans (same plain neo-grotesk build, large x-height)
primary = orange CTA, highlight = blue CTA, chart-2 = green status dot
